transcript:
Header:
2026-11-28 15:00 PST | Duration: 52m
Attendees: Jordan Lee (Redwood AE), Sofia Ramirez (Redwood CSM), Ethan Moore (Redwood SE); Angela Park (Bridgepoint Dir Eng), Marcus Chen (Head of Data), Sasha Rivera (Security & Compliance), Tom Bradley (DevOps)

Summary: Kickoff to align onboarding timeline, access, and security. Bridgepoint is evaluating private/dedicated for production but open to hosted pilot. Plan: share runbook, run benchmarks, confirm networking/VPC peering and compliance docs.

Topics: onboarding timeline, access & creds, VPC / peering, SOC2 / encryption / KMS, SSO/SAML & RBAC, pilot scope & success metrics, benchmark schedule, costing estimate.

[00:00] Jordan: Hi everyone, um, thanks for joining, we'll do quick intros, and then Sofia will run through the onboarding plan. We're scheduling about 50 minutes, so plenty of time for questions.
[00:18] Angela: Hi, Angela here, thanks, excited to get started.
[00:22] Marcus: Marcus from data, hey.
[00:24] Sasha: Sasha, security.
[00:26] Tom: Tom, DevOps.
[00:28] Jordan: Awesome. Sofia, over to you.
[00:30] Sofia: Thanks Jordan. Quick agenda: onboarding runbook, access and creds, security checklist, pilot scope / metrics, timeline, and followed by an SE deep dive for the benchmark. Uh mm-hmm.
[01:05] Ethan: I'll take the benchmarks section later, but real quick, we usually do an initial host pilot on Redwood hosted to validate prompts then move to dedicated or private for production, depends on compliance.
[01:18] Angela: We want to validate end-to-end latency and cost — and also need to know what network changes we need to do for VPC peering.
[01:30] Jordan: Totally. For peering we have a network playbook; we'll share the template. from a timing standpoint we can do hosted pilot within days, peering + private deploy takes a couple weeks pending approvals.
[01:46] Sasha: On compliance, do you have a current SOC 2 and encryption at rest details? We need KMS integration and audit logs — and we're on Azure, need region residency.
[01:58] Sofia: Yes — we have SOC 2 report, ISO overview, and KMS options. We'll share our standard security pack. Note that some proper nouns in the auto notes are fuzzy, but we'll attach the documents.
[02:15] Tom: For VPC peering we need CIDR details and whether Redwood supports AWS Transit Gateway — we run a hybrid infra.
[02:26] Ethan: We support VPC peering and private deployments, and we have guidance for TGW. For the hosted pilot you don't need peering, just API keys and restricted IP allowlist, which is easier.
[02:40] Marcus: For the benchmark we'll give you a sample payload set — about 20 prompts representative of our customer support use-case. Expected QPS is around 20 sustained, burst to 80.
[02:53] Jordan: Great, Marcus. That QPS helps us recommend batching and instance sizing.
[03:05] Angela: Quick question on data retention — logs, prompt retention? We need to know if Redwood stores prompts and for how long in hosted mode.
[03:16] Sofia: Hosted defaults to 30 days retention for traces but we have enterprise retention and never-store options for private deployments. We'll send the exact policy.
[03:28] Sasha: And encryption keys? We require customer-managed keys for production.
[03:33] Ethan: For private deployments yes, KMS/HSM integration is supported. For hosted, there are options for dedicated VMs with customer key support via partner KMS in some regions — we'll clarify.
[03:50] Angela: Pricing — can you give a rough estimate for the pilot? We want to budget for the POC.
[03:58] Jordan: For a short hosted pilot under 100k tokens it tends to be minor; rough number we'll attach in the follow up. For dedicated pricing we can provide committed capacity tiers.
[04:12] Tom: On the network side, who should we send the peering request to?
[04:15] Jordan: I'll send the network template and point of contact — Ethan will help with the technical checklist.
[04:22] Ethan: Yep, I'll be the technical lead for the benchmark. I'll share a checklist: sample prompts, expected QPS, auth, and sample telemetry metrics to collect.
[04:34] Marcus: We'll also want token-level cost estimates by prompt class so we can prioritize optimization.
[04:40] Jordan: We can run a small eval and return cost/latency per prompt class, yes.
[04:46] Sasha: About SSO and RBAC — we use Okta for SAML. How does Redwood handle SCIM and RBAC for teams?
[04:54] Sofia: We support SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning for user sync and team-level RBAC. We'll include docs for Okta and SAML setup.
[05:06] Angela: Timeline: our stakeholders expect a working pilot in ~2 weeks, production in 6-8 weeks after approvals. Is that feasible?
[05:16] Jordan: That sounds realistic: Hosted pilot can be done in 1-2 weeks. Private/dedicated will take more time for peering & security signoff.
[05:25] Sasha: We need to loop in procurement for contract terms and DPA.
[05:29] Sofia: We'll share standard DPA and procurement terms; if legal needs special addendums we'll escalate.
[05:36] Tom: On the infra side, what's required for our side to test end-to-end?
[05:40] Ethan: For hosted pilot: API keys, sample prompts, and a small harness to hit the API. For VPC/private: CIDR, firewall rules, and peering config.
[05:52] Angela: Ok, next steps then?
[05:55] Jordan: I'll recap but Ethan, Sofia — confirm the runbook items.
[05:59] Ethan: I'll own the benchmark schedule and checklist.
[06:03] Sofia: I'll send onboarding deck, security pack, and procurement docs.
[06:07] Marcus: We'll gather sample prompts and telemetry, and open the peering ticket.
[06:12] Sasha: I'll complete the compliance questionnaire and send SOC 2.
[06:16] Tom: I'll coordinate with Marcus on peering and infra.
[06:20] Jordan: Great. Any other questions?
[06:23] Angela: Not right now, I think that's everything.
[06:25] Jordan: Perfect we'll follow up with the packet and schedule for the benchmark. Thanks everyone.

(Transcription notes: occasional speaker attribution errors and filler words preserved. Some product names auto-transcribed oddly e.g., K V cache vs KV cache.)

Recap & explicit next steps: 
- Jordan to send onboarding deck, pricing, and network playbook (by 2026-11-30)
- Sofia to attach security pack (SOC2/ISO summary, KMS options) (by 2026-11-30)
- Ethan to schedule benchmark and send technical checklist (by 2026-12-03)
- Bridgepoint (Marcus/Tom) to provide sample prompts, telemetry, CIDR and open peering request (by 2026-12-01)
- Sasha to return completed compliance questionnaire and SOC2 report (by 2026-12-02)

End of transcript.
